reviews.text: I went for puppy preschool training, Logan enjoyed it and I did too…great way to introduce owners and puppies to training activities. I also brought Logan for his first doggy day care and he loves it 😎excellent staff and installations with real care for doggos

Brilliant puppy training.
Highly recommend it

Attended a recall masterclass with Tara and it was brilliant. The information was delivered in a fun easy to understand way. Tara was very knowledgeable and made sure to help with any specifics about each dog. Everything we went through in the class was emailed with videos so we won’t forget. Highly recommend.

I've used all their services started with daycare, then puppy training and also grooming. Never had a bad experience, they update you at the end of the day at pick up on behaviour,  concerns and you see pictures of all their activities on social media. Great shop attached as well and they recommended chews that actually last with my strong chewer of a dog.

After years bringing my Bernese mountain dogs to them they have decided they are too much work for them @ 125.00 each unless I bring them every 2 months.  I was always happy with their grooming but customer service is way off for that money!!
My dogs love going to daycare, they take such good care of them.
Great training for our pup. I highly recommend.

Great experience with dog Grooming here and the staff are super with the animals. We have a husky cross, so grooming is no mean feat and they always do a super job. Will continue to return here for great service.

Brought my dog for her first groom today, and the team couldn’t have been nicer. She’s a nervous dog and she pottered out afterwards calm, happy, and looking absolutely fabulous! We will definitely be back and I would recommend to anyone!
My dogs are loving the daycare always happy to leave them to play. Staff really nice snd helpful, believing they take good care and instagram is great touch to see happy dogs.

Hi Jose
Thanks for taking the time to leave a review, can I ask what of our services you used as we have no record of anyone with your name for training, grooming or daycare.
Thanks Liz
My dog loves going to the daycare here. She was a little nervous at first, but the team have been great with her.
We’ve been using PDT for the last 3 years with our golden and they have been nothing short of superb!

Dorothy is 4 years old and has been going to Liz and her team since she was a puppy for grooming and lots of fun in daycare. She gets so excited when she realises we are nearly there because she adores seeing both her human friends and dog friends. Such a caring team, so kind and very patient with a very stubborn 70kg+ St Bernard! If you are looking for lots of fun for your dog in a wonderful environment - look no further. If you are looking for superb grooming - look no further. And if you are looking for excellent training (especially with stubborn dogs!!) - look no further. Liz, Laura, Tara and the team are THE BEST.

We have a large greyhound Jack who can be a little shy. Positive Dog Training take the absolute best care of him and provide great advice on making sure Jack is in the best of health as how to manage his nails. Nobody else I trust with looking after him
Great care and attention at all times
The PDT Team go above and beyond. Cant thank you enough for all you do for Pandora 💛 …
